title: Domain-specific harness manifest (harness.json), spec 1 (with the 1.1 additions: kind, viewer.use)

kind.description: Spec 1.1. agent (default): a harness, one tile in the picker. viewer: a pane other packages point at with viewer.use; no engine, never a tile.

id.description: owner/name. The install directory under ~/.harness/dsh and the id on the wire.

category.description: The kind of thing it makes, in a word or two — PCB, 3D design, Slides. The picker's second line under the name.

author.description: Spec 1.1. Who made the agent — Autonomous for everything under autonomous/, a vendor name for a built-in engine — shown beside the category on the tile.

formerly.description: Ids this harness answered to before. An agent created under one keeps its harness across a rename.

engine.description: The base engine an agent package runs on: claude, codex, cursor, … (one of the CLI's ENGINES). Absent for a viewer package.

template.description: Directory copied into an empty workspace.

marker.description: Workspace-relative file whose presence means 'already materialized'.

init.description: Command run after the template copy, cwd = workspace.

instructions.description: File copied to <workspace>/AGENTS.md (appended under a marker if one exists).

skills.description: Directories whose SKILL.md-bearing subdirectories are linked into the workspace's skills folder.

env.description: Set on the engine process. Values may use ${dsh}, ${workspace}, ${home}.

args.description: Appended to the base engine's argv.

setup.description: Run once at install, cwd = install dir.

doctor.description: Exit 0 = ready. Each stdout line is shown to the user.

viewer.description: Spec 1.1: either the viewer this package ships (command + url) or, for a harness, the viewer package it uses (use).

command.description: Long-running; env HARNESS_VIEWER_PORT, HARNESS_WORKSPACE, HARNESS_DSH, HARNESS_DSH_DIR, HARNESS_VIEWER, HARNESS_VIEWER_DIR.

use.description: A viewer package's id. Installed with this harness (from the registry) and run in its own directory.

url.description: Optional: narrows the package's URL template.

verdict.description: Workspace-relative path of the verdict file. Default .harness/verdict.json.
